ModMetaData.name: RimOPT
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimOPT 0.4: Waylith/.NET10/Harmony3 work-search optimizations with fail-open safety gates: no non-authoritative reachability hooks, no foreign-patched GenClosest takeover, safe empty-workshop skips and bounded haul work. No asynchronous job deferral, scheduler replacement, or TickManager behavior change. RimWorld 1.6 work-search behavior remains in its original DLL.
